notes.title: Dungeons of Edera: 1.0 Release
notes.notes:
Hail adventurers!

The big day is here, three years in the making. 1.0 of Dungeons of Edera is now available!
I can't thank the folks who have been apart of the early access journey enough - you all helped me drive design, fix bugs, and gave excellent feedback to help make DOE what it is today.

So what does 1.0 mean for DoE?

I've completed what I have set out to complete for Dungeons of Edera, all of the base features are in that I initially planned. I will now be focusing on bugs and continuing to polish the core experience, and I ask that folks continue to join and report bugs in our discord, and continue to share their ideas.

First patch after 1.0 you can expect a remade Null Harbor!


[h2]1.0 [/h2]
[list]
[*] Localization Improvements
[*] Tutorial changes based on gamepad or keyboard
[*] UI Improvements for Keyboard and Gamepad
[*] Keybinds now update UI immediately
[*] AI Fireball is no longer homing
[*] Armor Talent Disassemble Fix
[*] other minor fixes
[/list]

notes.title: Dungeons of Edera: Pre 1.0 Patch
notes.notes:
Hail adventurers!

I am excited to announce we have picked a date for our 1.0 release - June 16th!

It has been a very long journey up to this point, over three years of solo development to get here, and this game has come such a long way thanks to the community for all their ideas and feedback given since DoE started early access in August 2020. 

While I started this project solo, the team grew over the years as I got some amazing people to jump onboard and help build out the storyline, create new environments, design spells, and drive our social media. These folks have been outstanding partners and I can't thank them enough for all the hard work they poured in this project. 

So what does 1.0 mean for DoE?

I've completed what I have set out to complete for Dungeons of Edera, all of the base features are in that I initially planned. I will now be focusing on bugs and continuing to polish the core experience, and I ask that folks continue to join and report bugs in our discord, and continue to share their ideas.

notes.title: Dungeons of Edera: Siege of the South Pt. 1
notes.notes:
Hail Adventurers!

Happy New year! This patch we are bringing the first iteration of the final campaign Quest, the Siege of the South! This is a three part dungeon, where you will first defend your siege weapons against waves of enemies, then you will storm into the fortress to plant explosives at key locations, before facing off against the final boss! This first iteration will be a rough test of the mechanics, with polish, cutscenes and the new boss to come later!

Along with this, we are introducing some balancing for items drops, reducing the drop chance for standard enemies and giving a huge buff to chests!

You will also be facing off against mini bosses! Starting at normal difficulty, Mini bosses will spawn throughout the map - Number of mini bosses increases with difficulty!


Check out the full details below

notes.title: Devblog 7/27/2020
notes.notes:
Hey all, Monster Tooth here with a quick update on DoE progress. 

I can't believe it is already the end of July, it feels like it flew by. Well team is making great progress towards our goal, still working on finishing up the first chapter of the campaign, but took a break to implement some cool new features and a major optimization that was needed!

In Drudgers keep, one of the main hubs that serve as your home base in chapter one, the city now feels much more alive as the NPCs go about their days wandering around, sitting in the tavern, watching the sunset or keeping watch if they are a guard. This was a fun one to see get turned on and really makes the hub feel much more immersive when you unlock this location. It's a big comparison to the small forest camp that the player will start the game from.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35666564/79684200268533cf70800a730f5306ee4058e544.png[/img]

I also finally got around to some companion improvements, creating a hud element for your companions, showing you their health. What drove me to get this done was the last part of chapter one, where you are accompanied by Scout Master Ramble Route, on your quests. 

As always, I am keeping an eye out for how to optimize the game - This past week I changed how enemy AI were navigating the world, and it was such a simple change! Even after two years working with this Engine there just all these small tweaks you can make to save performance here and there - but learning them is essentially the entire battle.



I have also started the process of beginning to voice the rest of the characters and get artists onboard to draw out the cutscenes. We are taking a graphic novel approach for the introduction of DoE and major story events, I am excited to see how it comes together. 

Getting closer and closer each week, within the next two weeks I should be announcing the official date of release!

notes.title: Dungeons of Edera: Road to Early Access
notes.notes:
Hey everyone, 
As we start winding down on development on what has been long road to early access, I wanted to start getting into the habit of providing regular updates as we approach our planned August release. 

MTS being only a very small team (three people) it is always a challenge to keep up the communication with the community while staying focused on development, but I want to give it a try. For folks who are looking for information on a more day to day basis, consider joining our Discord channel where you can interact with the team directly. discord.gg/dungeonsofedera  

I had a lot of hope that I would have hit my internal July target, but it became clear last month that was just not going to happen, so we made the decision to move it to the end of August to allow us to get the first chapter of the campaign and allow for a little soak time to catch any nasty surprises.

At this point in the development cycle, I feel we have a good base to launch from and start getting the players involved to really make Dungeons of Edera an enjoyable experience. Feedback and critique is vital to ensure the final product is really what the players want and most of all fun.  We have gotten good signal from the small player tests that we are on the right track so I am very excited to open this up to the next level for the entire Steam audience.

So - onto what the road to release and beyond looks like. At this point I am implementing the last leg of the first chapter of the campaign. The first chapter will take players through a guided tutorial and first two hub spaces where you will launch your missions and begin to build up your towns. In the next week or so the campaign should be finalized and at that point I will begin polishing and bug hunting to kick off the exciting part - inviting content creators and curators to have a go at it before I unleash it to the world. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35666564/c4bc460b61fe3452ecbc9f29dfaa9489c4f0dc66.png[/img]

Players can expect Dungeons of Edera early access to launch mid to late August - I will clarify the date on the next dev blog, I am hesitant to pick a date at this point in case I run into any unexpected problems. Depending on the initial feedback, I plan to stick to my roadmap on trello (https://trello.com/b/tarkmzyp/dungeons-of-edera-roadmap) as a basis, but will shuffle milestones around based on what players are calling out and excited to see.

That is it for this time, as I said, I will try to keep these posts coming on a weekly basis as we approach release and outline dates, new features and more details into the campaign.

Cheers,
Monster Tooth
(Mat)
